inputs.text: The duty of government is first to protect its own people and preserve the nation—not to stumble into an expanding war with no clear purpose. Strength matters, but so do discipline and judgment. Leaders who put civilians and essential infrastructure at needless risk are failing their most basic responsibility. National security requires resolve, restraint, and a clear account of what our interests actually are.
